\begin{tablenotes}\footnotesize
\item Gain = NDCG@10 with all donors of the channel pooled minus NDCG@10 with local data only (same model), both re-tuned on validation users. ItemKNN-ext is ItemKNN whose neighbour set and user profiles may include any product the target's evaluation users interacted with in the pooled data (not only target-catalog products); through users shared between categories of one market it is the only item-based model that can use the XC channel. $^a$ Provably blind combination: a donor that shares no product with the target catalog leaves the model unchanged (gain exactly 0; exactly-zero gains: MostPop/XC 74/74, ItemKNN/XC 73/73, EASE/XC 72/72, MostPop/XX 74/74, ItemKNN/XX 73/73, ItemKNN-ext/XX 73/73, EASE/XX 72/72). $^b$ Identical estimator to ItemKNN on XM, because target users hold no donor-only products. Results come from the core grid, which was stopped before completion: 24,754 unit records (56 with an error); of the 74 contexts, a row lacks ca Books (EASE/XC, EASE/XM, EASE/XX; EASE skips catalogs over 4,000 products); ca CDs \& Vinyl (EASE/XM, ItemKNN-ext/XM, ItemKNN/XM, MostPop/XM, PureSVD/XM; no donor in this channel); uk Books (EASE/XC, EASE/XM, EASE/XX, ItemKNN-ext/XC, ItemKNN-ext/XM, ItemKNN-ext/XX, ItemKNN/XC, ItemKNN/XX, PureSVD/XC, PureSVD/XM, PureSVD/XX; not run (grid stopped)). PureSVD uses an iterative sparse SVD (ARPACK) on catalogs over 1,500 products and a dense eigendecomposition otherwise; its scores are deterministic for a fixed software stack but are not bit-reproducible across numerical libraries. Better/Worse: gain above $+0.01$ / below $-0.01$. CIs: two-way cluster bootstrap over countries and categories.
\end{tablenotes}
